description: Explicit coverage scope registry for the Omni Translate driver layer. Each entry declares whether a production unit is exempt (vendored) or requires native smoke coverage.

entries.reason: Vendored Microsoft SYSVAD sample (UPSTREAM-COMMIT.txt, UPSTREAM-LICENSE.txt). Not Omni-authored; upstream owns correctness.
Omni-authored production ring buffer (~360 lines) compiled into the driver binary. Core logic extracted to include/omni_ring_core.h for user-mode smoke.
Omni-authored header declaring the bridge ring kernel API surface.
Portable ring-buffer core extracted for user-mode testability. Directly exercised by the native smoke test.
Omni-authored IOCTL ABI contract shared between driver and bridge service.
Omni-authored driver manifest and stub sources. Must have coverage once they exceed stub status.

policies.newOmniProductionFile: Any new non-vendored C/C++ production file under drivers/ MUST be registered here with scope=native-smoke-required and a valid testTarget before merge.
policies.newWdkCompilationUnit: WDK project additions of Omni compilation units require a corresponding native test target entry.
policies.missingTestTarget: If a testTarget file does not exist, the coverage gate MUST fail.
policies.exemptionInheritance: New files MUST NOT silently inherit exempt status from a parent glob. Each Omni-authored file requires explicit registration.
